tagline: a personal studio for tech experiments and aesthetic design
brief: A personal studio for things Daniel likes building: apps, experiments, a logbook and a museum of unfinished ideas. Swiss, black and white, with colour left to the projects.
criteria: Works at 16 px, in one colour, reversed, and next to four very different project brands without competing with them.

concepts.name: Frame
concepts.idea: A square head with the idea sitting inside it, off-centre, where a thought would be.
rationale: Two shapes on one grid: a 28-unit frame and a 56-unit idea, nothing else
The idea sits off-centre on purpose: structure with a little mess inside
A pixel-snapped 16 px cut keeps the favicon crisp
Lowercase Geist wordmark matches the site's own voice

recommendation: Frame, with the lowercase wordmark. Black on paper by default, paper on black in dark mode.
next_steps: Follow guidelines.md for spacing and minimum sizes
